rationale: Edge-case lens and standards ran; acceptance skipped (no spec), so confidence is low. One blocking commit-format partial (ticket key in both commit subjects); 2 advisory edge findings with reachability unconfirmed (nested-native launch-endpoint inheritance, pin id source); 0 deferred, 0 dismissed.

standards_review.notes: 2 subjects use allowed types (fix, refactor), allowed scope agents and are under 100 chars; both embed the ticket key EPMCDME-17845 in the subject, which git-workflow.md Anti-Patterns says to put in the body footer instead

7 changed files; optional env param added with typed signatures, .js/@ alias imports, explicit return types, why-comments, no console.log or any introduced; executeEnrichArgs reaches 5 params, within the 4-5 guideline
new CODEMIE_COPILOT_LAUNCH_BASE_URL env carries a non-secret endpoint only, no logging added, no attribution header or injection path touched; spawnEnv mutation is limited to the pin env var

findings.title: Ticket key in commit subjects
findings.problem: Commits 346240c8 and 3229d0a1 put EPMCDME-17845 in the subject; git-workflow.md Anti-Patterns says a ticket key in the subject is to be avoided when scope conveys context.
findings.impact: Documented commit-format convention is not fully met (standards partial); blocks per the standards rule, though the squash PR title may carry the ticket.
findings.recommendation: move the ticket reference to the commit body footer, or rely on the squash PR title, which carries the ticket

findings.title: Inherited launch endpoint may misclassify nested native
findings.problem: A native copilot hook inheriting CODEMIE_COPILOT_LAUNCH_BASE_URL from a managed parent shell, with COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL absent, falls back to the launcher endpoint and can look CodeMie-routed.
findings.impact: Narrow trigger (native Copilot nested inside a managed session); a new funding claim also requires a fresh start whose id matches the pin, which narrows it further. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: only fall back when the hook's session id matches the pinned launch session, or scrub LAUNCH_PROVIDER_BASE_URL_ENV from nested spawns

findings.title: Pin id read from process.env, not spawnEnv
findings.problem: enrichArgs reads CODEMIE_SESSION_ID from process.env but writes the pin to both process.env and spawnEnv.
findings.impact: Only differs if the two envs carry different CODEMIE_SESSION_ID; spawn env is built from process.env so normally identical. Reachability unconfirmed.
